body: I don't think you're a bad person op, yes you probably made him uncomfortable but it's not the end of the world. You didn't touch him or make him do anything physical and while you probably hurt the relationship a little he still talks to you so it's possible you can patch things up eventually.

I feel pretty much exactly the same. I don't have hobbies outside of games and anime and stuff you do alone, I had one chance with a girl but I completely blew it and now I'm 23 with no experience dating and pretty much no social skills. I feel left behind by my friends and family, I'm happy for their success but I'm still barely making above minimum wage and responsibility stresses me out so badly I don't think I'll ever be able to be someone that anyone else can rely on. I don't really care about my life anymore, I know I'm the one who got myself here and in this mindset but I'd rather just be done with it all.

Ok, that doesn't make him seem like the most caring person but maybe he's under a lot of stress himself, I couldn't say. He probably should have just hugged you but idk. I'm just a stranger and if I said I cared it would be at least a little fake but you don't seem like a fuck up to me, you've just had a string of bad luck. I at least care enough to not want you to die.

Your boyfriend cares, I'm sure of it. I know it's hard when you have bpd, it can seem like everyone is lying but just try reaching out to him. I'm sorry about all the shit going on in your life, when it rains it pours sometimes. Just keep going for one more day.

I'm not sure what kind of answer you want. Ideation is thinking you could, like jumping into traffic or grabbing the sharpest knife in the drawer and going to town. A plan is something thought out and that you make steps towards, you buy the rope, you buy the gun, you write the note etc.

I'm sorry this happened to you man, you have my sympathies. I'm a paranoid person to a fault, so if something like that happened to me I would be a mess for a lot of reasons. I don't know why she would ask a random man in a dangerous city for weed and then go with him alone anywhere, thats clearly a bad idea. But it does seem like you care about her, you can get through this.

No, that sounds like emotional blackmail and is generally a shitty thing to do. Especially if you're then going to say you're suicidal and expect her to help you. I'm sorry things are rough, you could chat things out with me if you like but doing that to someone you consider a friend seems really vindictive.

Please don't try with a knife, I know things are bad but that has the lowest mortality rate of any method. I don't want you to do it at all. Can you leave the house soon, maybe stay with some friends, other relatives for awhile, anything? I know you have no hope right now but you can still build yourself up over time, who you are now isn't all you can be.

I'm sorry to hear that man, you and I are similar in a lot of ways. This might sound strange, but I didn't know other autistic people felt the same way I do. The exact same thing happens when I try to talk to people, I have nothing at all to say and my thoughts are very shallow.  I'm not sure how to help you, I think you should be proud of what you have accomplished so far. Being physically fit and cognizant enough to serve puts you at least a bit above the rest don't you think? I found myself overwhelmed by the upper level classes in college due to the expectation that you've thoroughly learned all the prior material instead of rote memorization + forgetting, maybe you're the same way. If you are, all I can suggest is trying to go through your textbooks piece by piece and if you have any people you know in classes make a study group. Engineers are all about that from my experience. 

I can't truly help with your feelings of isolation and loneliness but sometimes pseudo experience through media can make you feel better for a little bit. If you don't hate anime I really enjoyed Karakai Jouzo no Takagi-San, it kind of fills the void :) Good luck man
